title: Community
introduction: SNES projects are better with a community. Join us on Discord to meet other creators, share what you are working on, and talk about the Super Nintendo.

servers.name: SNEStorage
servers.label: Official SNEStorage community
servers.description: Join the official SNEStorage Discord to share resources, discuss SNES projects, ask questions, and help shape the future of the website. This is the main home for our community.

connectionTitle: How to join and link your account
connectionIntroduction: You must have a registered SNEStorage account with a confirmed email address. Choose one of the two methods below to link your Discord account.

steps.text: Sign in to your SNEStorage account.
Open the rules channel, read the rules, and press Allow Access.
Sign in to SNEStorage and open your profile.
Press Connect to Discord. This links the Discord account you are currently signed in to and redirects you to the SNEStorage server.
Join the server from the redirect, or use the invite below.
Open the rules channel, read the rules, and press Allow Access.

sections.title: Share your projects
sections.text: Show what you are making, exchange ideas, and discover what other creators are working on.

sections.title: Learn together
sections.text: Ask questions, discuss resources, and share what you have learned about SNES development and hacking.

sections.title: Meet the community
sections.text: Connect with fellow SNES fans and creators, from your first project to your next release.

guidelinesText: Keep conversations welcoming, respect other creators, and follow the SNEStorage rules.
